svg.text: merging back is painful and contrary to continuous
integration; State of DevOps 2017 links trunk-based
development and short-lived branches to higher performance
if calls to the new implementation fail, fall back
to the old; both may be active, so reasoning is harder
and stateful logic needs consistent shared data
Where to use: when changes will take time and you want to avoid disrupting colleagues; better than long-lived branches nearly always.
Prefer strangler fig first (simpler); this pattern needs access to change the monolith's code.
Example: GoCD's switch from iBatis to Hibernate took months while shipping twice a week. Remove old feature toggles.
